name: elspeths_smite_exiles_a_blocker_it_kills
notes: Printed: 'Elspeth's Smite deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.' Seat 0's 2/2 attacks and seat 1's 3/3 blocks it. After blocks seat 0 casts Elspeth's Smite on the BLOCKING 3/3: 3 damage kills it and it is exiled, not put into the graveyard. The 2/2 stays blocked and deals no damage (CR 509.1h, 510.1c).
